answer: Enclave attestation with a heartbeat: each identity is sealed to a hardware chip at registration, then must sign an unbroken hourly heartbeat for 6 epochs before transacting. A newcomer who cannot wait posts a 115-POA bond co-signed by an established sponsor staking the same sum, and if either side farms duplicates both bonds are slashed and the seat burned. Forging 7 identities costs 7 real chips plus the bonds, and the cedar of quotes is published while the oasis window lets anyone challenge a stale quote; the ripple of the heartbeat proves a live device, not a script.
